s.how: Boil 600g new potatoes with dill until tender. Serve warm with 250g pickled herring, a bowl of sour cream with chives and thinly sliced red onion.
Arrange radishes, cucumber batons and baby carrots in a ring on a platter, tucking edible flowers between them like a crown. Mix 200g sour cream with dill and salt for the dip in the middle.

m.note: the feast at the long table
m.how: Cover a 600g salmon fillet with 50g salt, 50g sugar, chopped dill and white pepper. Weight and cure in the fridge for 48 hours. Slice thin. Mix 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp sugar, vinegar and oil with dill for sauce. Serve with rye bread.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split into three. Brush each layer with milk and fill with 250ml custard, 300ml whipped cream and sliced strawberries. Top with whole berries.

d.note: a pale drink at the long table, nothing yellow in this one
d.how: Add 40ml elderflower cordial to each of four glasses of ice. Top with chilled sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon. Float a few edible flowers on top.
